name: Monolayer lift-off (3D)
blurb: A 3D monolayer with apical/basal surfaces: an apical purse-string (line tension on every apical edge) contracts the top face while cell volume is conserved, so the sheet buckles into a dome and the apical opening cinches shut into a lumenoid (~99% closed by the end). Orbit to watch it curl up and close.
